meta.title: Thank you for helping cats in need
meta.description: Thank you for your gift to Happy Paws Cat Rescue. Here is what happens next.

s1.h1:
Thank you for 
helping cats 
==in need==
s1.p: Your gift means we can keep rescuing, rehabilitating and rehoming cats who need us.
s1.p2: A receipt is on its way to your inbox.
s1.alt: A ginger kitten nestled in a soft grey blanket, looking up at the camera

s2.p: Your gift matters. If you'd like to do a little more, here are some easy next steps.
s2.p2: Tell your friends and family about Happy Paws. Every share helps a cat find help.
s2.p3: Get rescue stories and adoption updates in your inbox. We'll only email you if you sign up here.
s2.label: Email address
s2.p4: A cake sale, car boot, quiz night or coffee morning. We'd be overjoyed to hear your idea.
